machine: HP laptop: Intel i7-8550U (4 cores, 8 threads, AVX2), 15.9 GB RAM, Wi-Fi only. WSL sees 7.8 GB. Also NVIDIA MX150 (2 GB) and Intel UHD 620.
model: Gemma 3n E4B and E2B, Q4_0 GGUF (unsloth) for llama.cpp. MLX 4-bit (mlx-community) for MLX.

mlx_cpu_0.32.2_linux_wsl2.note: About 1.8 GFLOP/s at M=256, one core busy. Model warm-up (16 tokens) did not finish in 7+ minutes. Unusable.
mlx_cpu_0.32.2_linux_wsl2.windows: import works only after installing mlx-cpu (mlx.dll) next to mlx; speed not measured, same CPU backend

decision: Windows and Linux use llama.cpp on the CPU (patched, prepared file). The Mac keeps MLX: llama.cpp on Metal measured slower or equal.
size_effect_on_hp: E2B answers 1.7x (Windows) and 1.7x (Linux) faster than E4B, so the size knob matters on this laptop.

mac_m5_metal.verdict: MLX is as fast or faster (prompt +17%, answer equal), uses less memory, and has the instant small size. The Mac keeps MLX.
